name: BeamDrop
highlights: ⚡ Direct Download QR Gateway: Phone browser directly triggers file download dialog without opening full website
🔄 Over-The-Air Update Engine: In-extension Updates tab with 1-click update check and package download
📦 Dynamic Staging & Backpressure: Prevents buffer saturation when streaming 4K video or large archives
🛡️ Manifest V3 CSP Compliant: 100% offline self-contained CSS, Canvas QR engine, and local scripts

changelog.title: Direct Download Gateway & OTA Update System
changes: Direct Phone Download: Scanning QR immediately prompts native browser download for that specific file
Dedicated Updates Tab in extension with live GitHub/Vercel release check
Automatic version comparison & 1-click update ZIP package download
Complete release history timeline with detailed changelogs

changelog.title: Staging Area & Flow Control
changes: Multi-file staging container before generating QR code
64KB chunk backpressure control to prevent buffer saturation
Fixed logo sizing and offline pure CSS rendering

changelog.title: Initial Manifest V3 Launch
changes: Zero cloud storage and zero database
